comparison_notes.iou_only: unchanged real FaceTracker, IoU=.3; recorded max_age for all methods
comparison_notes.iou_relaxed_control: unchanged real FaceTracker with offline IoU=.05 control, not production
comparison_notes.geometry: offline greedy score=.5*IoU+.3*max(0,1-center/.6)+.2*size; all gates must pass
comparison_notes.geometry_conservative: geometry plus mutual best and top-two margin >=.15 on both sides; no second-choice fallback
comparison_notes.center: Euclidean center distance / max(old bbox diagonal, new bbox diagonal)
comparison_notes.experimental_only: exploratory gates/weights, not calibrated, no appearance or motion prediction

metric_definitions.id_changes: actor assigned a different track than its previous labeled observation, including after a miss
metric_definitions.false_continuations: track reused by a different labeled actor; zero is not correctness proof
metric_definitions.ground_truth: external manual/synthetic actor labels only; Student/Person/Face IDs never supply truth
metric_definitions.unlabeled: identity metrics null when no actors; partial labels yield incomplete lower-bound counts
metric_definitions.new_ids_after_first_frame: mechanical births after initial frame; includes new arrivals, NOT identity switches
metric_definitions.expiry: observed age > shared max_age before matching; no artificial final flush
